name: QUEST-QI
description: Brings the released tree up to the manuscript prepared for ACM Transactions on Information Systems. Manuscript converted to the acmart format and retitled; the LNCS build is retired. Related work rewritten: 37 references to 61. New per-family results: nDCG@10 and recall@100 for every system against all six question families, with 95 percent confidence intervals for the systems the argument turns on. Verifier extended: a count-and-superlative claim class, a value-rendering check, and a page-floor check. 987 bindings, 0 failures. The arXiv packaging script is removed; this work is not routed to arXiv.
